title: Understand and improve retention
summary: Retention shows whether people keep getting value. Without it, growth leaks away.

beginner: Pick the action that shows someone got value.
Measure how many new users come back and do it again after a day, a week and a month.
Compare groups who stay with groups who leave.
Talk to people who left to learn why.
Test changes that help people reach value sooner.
experienced: Separate new, current and returning users.

toolExamples.amplitude: Use a retention analysis chart by sign-up cohort.
toolExamples.mixpanel: Use retention reports to compare cohorts.

pitfalls: Focusing on acquisition while users leave

leaderView.good: Teams understand who keeps using the product, who leaves and why.
ask: How does retention look for recent groups of new users, and why?
Which actions predict that someone will stay?
signs: Growth reports show sign-ups but not retention.
New users are acquired faster than they leave, hiding the problem.
